intent: Extend existing Android coding workspace with bound worker/agent/environment boards, review workspace and durable controls while retaining phone-only workflows.

validation.details: 616 Python repository policy/regression tests; Android regex and resource preflight; generated architecture/audit inventory checks; diff and secret checks.

validation.command: Kotlin 2.4.20 + real Compose compiler and Android SDK 37 signatures
validation.details: All changed/new workspace UI, actual ViewModel/models and GitHubCodeDiff compiled; 26 domain and ViewModel tests passed. Existing platform/repository boundaries are mocked; this is not full Gradle/Hilt or device qualification.

Full actual GatewayEngineeringClient and new command store compiled with actual network exchange/metadata code and mocked platform boundaries; exact repository workspace-method block/config/save compiled. 26 client/repository/store tests passed, including lost responses, identity fences, encrypted retention, credentials changed during checkpoint persistence, strict readback, explicit retry/dismissal, unresolved command acknowledgement without replay, per-ID historical readback, unvalidated imported candidates and pinned file pages.
All changed/new Kotlin source and test files pass ktlint 1.3.1.

integration_notes: Gateway is optional; existing phone-native GitHub flows remain in their original controller.
Full Gradle/Hilt, emulator/device and exact integrated-head CI belong to the parent integration and publication gates.
Agent runtimes, credentials and optional MCP tools are selected only from the Gateway host approved catalog; no arbitrary executable, URL or model switch from phone.

Command arguments use existing encrypted workspace storage. Plain binding metadata retains only operation identity/status and encrypted argument reference; source-bearing command results are ephemeral readback.
Requirements bound follows backend admission maximum256; workers8, terminals3 and source/blob paging are bounded.

Explicit acknowledgement retains UNKNOWN commands and their encrypted argument reference in a bounded durable list. Only advertised maintenance and private review drafts are allowed while the parent waits for input; each original ID remains independently readable and no command is replayed.

Receipt reasons use fixed codes; large encrypted result references remain visible. Imported candidate rows accept an absent check index and are explicitly labeled unvalidated. Non-runnable products appear only as workflow or connector references.
